description: This file defines the OrderController class, a web API controller responsible for handling order-related actions such as retrieving the current user's orders and order details. It utilizes MediatR for handling requests and incorporates authorization and validation guards.

classes.name: OrderController
classes.description: A controller class managing order-related routes, requiring user authorization. It interacts with MediatR to retrieve order data and renders respective views.

methods.name: MyOrders
methods.description: Handles GET requests to retrieve all orders for the authenticated user by sending a 'GetMyOrders' request via MediatR and returning the result in a view.

methods.name: Detail
methods.description: Handles GET requests to retrieve details of a specific order identified by orderId for the authenticated user. Returns a bad request if the order is not found.
